{{nihongo|'''Arai Shrine (Nantan)'''|荒井神社 (南丹市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Tanba Province]].

'''Arai Shrine''' (あらいじんじゃ) is a Shinto shrine located in Yagi-chō Misato, {{ill|Nantan, Kyoto|Q170421|qid=Q170421}}, {{ill|Kyoto Prefecture|Q120730|qid=Q120730}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} {{ill|Shikinai Ronsha|ja|論社|qid=Q135022904}}, and under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=former shrine rank}} it was classified as a {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}.

=== Enshrined deity ===
* Aramitama-no-kami

There is also a theory that the enshrined deity is {{ill|Umashimaji|Q10946169|qid=Q10946169|lt=Umashimaji-no-Mikoto}}, the ancestral deity of the Mononobe clan.<ref>“Place Names of Kyoto Prefecture,” entry on Arai Shrine.</ref>
 
=== History ===
The date of establishment is unknown. In the entry for the 9th day of the 10th month of {{ill|Gangyō|Q747451|qid=Q747451}} 6 ({{ill|882|Q23824|qid=Q23824}}) in the '{{ill|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|Q1052981|qid=Q1052981}}', there is a record of the Arai deity of Tanba Province being granted the Junior Fifth Rank, confirming the shrine’s existence at that time.

Because the shrine is an old shrine within the district and because the area was formerly called “Shima-gō,” it is regarded as a {{ill|Shikinai Ronsha|ja|論社|qid=Q135022904}} for the Shikinaisha “{{ill|Tanba Province|cs|Tanba (provincie)|de|Provinz Tamba|es|Provincia de Tanba|fa|ولایت تانبا|fr|Province de Tanba|gl|Provincia de Tanba|id|Provinsi Tamba|it|Tanba (provincia)|ja|丹波国|ko|단바국|lt|Tambos žemė|nl|Tamba (provincie)|pt|Província de Tanba|ru|Тамба (провинция)|simple|Tamba Province|sk|Tanba (provincia)|sr|Провинција Тамба|tr|Tamba (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Тамба|zh|丹波國|zh_min_nan|Tanba-kok|qid=Q954511}} {{ill|Funai District, Kyoto|Q1078679|qid=Q1078679}} Shima Mononobe Shrine” listed in the '{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}' from the mid-{{ill|Heian period|Q193292|qid=Q193292}}.<ref>Note that the 'Tanba Shisō Senki' identifies it with the Shikinaisha “Shitahi Shrine” in the same district (“Place Names of Kyoto Prefecture,” entry on Arai Shrine).</ref>

Adjacent to the shrine is Saikō-ji Temple, and until the {{ill|Shinbutsu bunri|Q1970535|qid=Q1970535}}, the shrine had no Shinto priests; monks from Saikō-ji performed the rites.<ref>[https://tanbarakuichi.sakura.ne.jp/shrine/yagi/01.html#y004 Arai Shrine] ([https://tanbarakuichi.sakura.ne.jp/shrine/index.html Shrines of Tanba] [personal website])</ref>

Construction or repairs were carried out in {{ill|Eishō (Muromachi period)|Q1193577|qid=Q1193577}} 16 ({{ill|1519|Q6278|qid=Q6278}}), {{ill|Eiroku|Q1143341|qid=Q1143341}} 9 ({{ill|1566|Q6638|qid=Q6638}}), and {{ill|Meireki|Q1192766|qid=Q1192766}} 3 ({{ill|1657|Q6987|qid=Q6987}}), and the ridge plaques from those times still survive.

In {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} 6 ({{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}}), under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines}}, it was designated a {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}.

=== Grounds ===
* Main hall — Believed to date from the late {{ill|Muromachi period|Q334845|qid=Q334845}}. One-bay {{ill|Nagare-zukuri|Q210684|qid=Q210684}} with {{ill|cypress bark roof|Q90373477|qid=Q90373477}}. Designated a Tangible Cultural Property of Kyoto Prefecture.

=== Cultural properties ===
=== Kyoto Prefecture–designated cultural properties ===
* Tangible Cultural Property
** Arai Shrine Main Hall (with one protective structure and two ridge plaques) — Designated on March 24, 2023 (Reiwa 5).<ref>From the Kyoto Prefecture Official Gazette dated March 24, 2023, Kyoto Prefectural Board of Education Notification No. 2 (link to the Kyoto Prefecture website).</ref>

Before being designated as a Kyoto Prefecture–designated Tangible Cultural Property, the main hall was registered as a Kyoto Prefecture Registered Tangible Cultural Property in 1988 (Shōwa 63) and designated as a Yagi Town Tangible Cultural Property (later Nantan City Tangible Cultural Property) in 1985 (Shōwa 60).
